# Govind Gupta

Data Engineer and Java Spring Boot developer.

## About

Govind Gupta builds scalable data pipelines and backend systems. He designs and
maintains Databricks Spark SQL data pipelines, builds datamarts and catalog
blocks, and engineers reusable asset bundles for modular data services. He is
currently a Specialist Programmer at Infosys and has interned at Skepsi.ai and
IIIT Vadodara.

## Role

- Specialist Programmer, Infosys (June 2025 - Present)
- SDE Intern, Skepsi.ai (June 2024 - September 2024)
- Summer Research Intern, IIIT Vadodara (May 2024 - June 2024)
- Open Source Contributor, Social Winter of Code (January 2024 - February 2024)

## Tech Stack

- Data: Databricks, Spark SQL, PySpark, ETL Pipelines, Data Quality
- Languages: Python, Java, SQL
- Backend: Java Spring Boot, REST APIs, Kafka, Redis
- Cloud & Data Stores: Azure, MongoDB, PostgreSQL
- Other: Docker, Linux, Git
